_note: Owner's manual picks for the Salient column, applied last. {work_id: {why_en, why_zh}} adds; {work_id: null} removes.

kshitij-parashar--who-ar-you.why_en: A character floats above your head that everyone in the room can see except you.
kshitij-parashar--who-ar-you.why_zh: 一个角色悬在你头顶，房间里所有人都看得见，唯独你自己看不见。

markus-lanxinger--postmark.why_en: A postcard on the fridge speaks only while you look at it, and waits quietly when you look away.
markus-lanxinger--postmark.why_zh: 贴在冰箱上的明信片，只有你看着它时才开口说话，移开视线它就安静地等着。

calvin-dong--pic-seeker.why_en: A photo cuts a hole in the room, and the next player has to find the real spot that fills it.
calvin-dong--pic-seeker.why_zh: 一张照片在房间里挖出一个洞，下一位玩家要找到能把它补上的真实位置。

harry-banda--memory-grid.why_en: You remember the path by walking it on the real floor instead of tapping it.
harry-banda--memory-grid.why_zh: 记住的路线要用双脚在真实地板上走出来，而不是用手指点出来。

pieter-siekerman--transitview.why_en: You see the bus coming around the corner while a building still hides it.
pieter-siekerman--transitview.why_zh: 公交车还被楼挡着，你已经能看见它从拐角开过来。

awu-chen--wake-them-up.why_en: The objects in a room tell the dreams of the person who used to live with them.
awu-chen--wake-them-up.why_zh: 房间里的物件替不在场的主人讲出他们的梦。

hart-woolery--tech-deck-specs.why_en: Two fingers become a skater riding a tiny skatepark on a café table.
hart-woolery--tech-deck-specs.why_zh: 两根手指变成滑板手，在咖啡桌上的迷你滑板场里滑行。

imogen-heap--sound-space-specs.why_en: The air around her body becomes a loop station she plays with her hands and voice.
imogen-heap--sound-space-specs.why_zh: 她身体周围的空气变成一台循环录音机，用手和声音来演奏。

vincent-guigui--lyrics-everywhere.why_en: A song's lyrics turn up in the world: on a rabbit's sign, a plane's banner, and in speech bubbles over passers-by.
vincent-guigui--lyrics-everywhere.why_zh: 歌词出现在真实世界里：兔子举的牌子上、飞机拖的横幅上，还有路人头顶的对话气泡里。

david-lindlbauer--shadows-of-reality.why_en: Your private virtual windows cast real shadows on the floor, so people nearby know not to walk through them.
david-lindlbauer--shadows-of-reality.why_zh: 你私人的虚拟窗口在地板上投下真实的影子，让身边的人知道别从中间走过。

mit-fluid-interfaces--allegory-of-the-ca.why_en: A shadow character on the wall wants to switch off the real light, and you stop him by moving real objects into his way.
mit-fluid-interfaces--allegory-of-the-ca.why_zh: 墙上的影子角色想关掉真正的灯，你只能把真实的物体挡在他面前来阻止他。

qingzhu-zhang--taste-as-form.why_en: Every bite becomes a shape above your plate, so you can see what you taste.
qingzhu-zhang--taste-as-form.why_zh: 每吃一口，盘子上方就长出一个形状，让你看见自己尝到的味道。

judith-amores--storycaster.why_en: Tell a story out loud and the walls of the room become it.
judith-amores--storycaster.why_zh: 把故事讲出来，房间的墙就变成故事本身。

takashi-yoshinaga--finger-framing-copy-p.why_en: Frame a real object with your fingers and it becomes a copy you can paste anywhere.
takashi-yoshinaga--finger-framing-copy-p.why_zh: 用手指框住一个真实物体，它就变成可以随处粘贴的副本。

laan-labs--sonar-ruler.why_en: Your phone measures the room by echo, like a bat.
laan-labs--sonar-ruler.why_zh: 手机像蝙蝠一样，靠回声测量房间。

studio-roosegaarde--seeing-stars-aarhus.why_en: A whole city switches off its lights, and the stars become the artwork.
studio-roosegaarde--seeing-stars-aarhus.why_zh: 整座城市关灯，星星就成了作品。

hideki-koike--gaze-contingent-dual-anima.why_en: Follow the character with your eyes and a hidden second animation appears.
hideki-koike--gaze-contingent-dual-anima.why_zh: 用眼睛追随角色，一段隐藏的动画就会出现。

shan-yuan-teng--see-through-with-the-han.why_en: A camera on the wrist lets your hand see behind objects.
shan-yuan-teng--see-through-with-the-han.why_zh: 手腕上的摄像头让你的手看见物体背后。

yukang-yan--remapping-time.why_en: The headset slows reality down for a moment so you catch what flashed by.
yukang-yan--remapping-time.why_zh: 头显把现实放慢片刻，让你看清一闪而过的东西。

shin-hanagata--chimeria.why_en: Your eye moves to your toes, and your feet become your head.
shin-hanagata--chimeria.why_zh: 眼睛搬到脚趾上，脚就成了头。

ujoo-limheeyoung--no-bird.why_en: One machine leaves a bird's footprints and another erases them.
ujoo-limheeyoung--no-bird.why_zh: 一台机器留下鸟的脚印，另一台把它们抹掉。

harry-banda--who-let-the-flies-in.why_en: Catch the flies in your room with a pair of chopsticks.
harry-banda--who-let-the-flies-in.why_zh: 用一双筷子夹住房间里的苍蝇。

studio-roosegaarde--waterlicht.why_en: A sheet of blue light overhead shows how high the water could rise.
studio-roosegaarde--waterlicht.why_zh: 头顶的一片蓝光，标出水可能涨到的高度。

4th-wall-breakers--wormhole-electric-co.why_en: Put a hand into one hole and it comes out of another across the room.
4th-wall-breakers--wormhole-electric-co.why_zh: 把手伸进一个洞，它从房间另一头的洞里伸出来。

william-forsythe--uplifting-instruction.why_en: AR planes tow an instruction across the sky, and reading it makes you lift your head.
william-forsythe--uplifting-instruction.why_zh: AR 飞机拖着一条指令飞过天空，要读它就得抬起头。

ville-makela--pause-and-play.why_en: Pause VR and your avatar stays standing in your real room like a bookmark.
ville-makela--pause-and-play.why_zh: 暂停 VR，你的化身留在真实房间里，像一枚书签。

tung-yen-chou--shifting-connections.why_en: Bodies become points and closeness becomes lines, so a group sees its own distances.
tung-yen-chou--shifting-connections.why_zh: 身体是点、靠近是线，一群人看见彼此的距离。
